purpose: Curated navigation notes only. Commands, implementation paths, and parameters are discovered from source; these notes do not select project rules or supply executable arguments.

plan.description: 固定输入、逐图任务和阶段路由；不执行全部提取。
notes: Choose a new output directory and bind the actual project configuration. A routing plan is not a completed reconstruction.

validate.description: 校验已有任务阶段契约。
notes: Exit 0/2/1 means passed/pending/failed. Artifact and contract checks do not establish source topology or human acceptance.

validate-known-rule-batch.description: 验证已生成的同类规则批处理产物。
notes: This command validates an existing batch run. It does not infer a rule or generate a project-specific manifest.

validate-full-batch-plan-fusion.description: 验证全批次平面属性融合产物。
notes: Use the actual source-bound fusion run. Passing the checker is separate from current viewer publication and human acceptance.

package-current-review.description: 按明确绑定与哈希封装当前专家复核查看器。
notes: The delegated entry point requires binding, binding-sha256 and a new output path. A runnable review package does not certify raw-input reconstruction or human acceptance.

receive-current-review-answers.description: 接收指定问题的专家答复并保留来源收据。
notes: Receiving answers is separate from native rule application, source replay, publication and acceptance. Existing answers, reply, page-root, output and question-id are explicit owner arguments.

merge-current-source-review-queue.description: 合并当前源图复核队列。
notes: Merging a queue does not resolve its questions or replace source validation.
